newsitem.title: PERU: Peru cenbanker says drugs bring in $600 mln a year.
newsitem.headline: Peru cenbanker says drugs bring in $600 mln a year.

text.p: The president of Peru's Central Reserve Bank, German Suarez, said narcotics trafficking brings $600 million a year into the local financial system.
However, he added that the drug trade was no longer an important factor in the currency market because of the recent influx of foreign currency for investment in Peru.
"The influence of the 'narco-dollars' was important in the years when the economy was closed, but now the capital flows (for investment) are more important," he told reporters.
Peru is the world's largest producer of coca leaf, the raw product for cocaine.
